supersedes: wp1b_calibration_gate (v1). CG-1..CG-9 unchanged; CG-10 and CG-11 added. v1 is preserved as history.
scope: Calibration-3b instrumentation/protocol sanity gate. NOT a performance gate. Calibration is an instrumentation sanity check, not an opportunity to tune the method against performance. Calibration-3 is reclassified prospectively as GATE_V1_PASS / INSTRUMENT_INVALID; MAIN_297 is blocked until a clean Calibration-3b.

checks.description: 3/3 requested calibration tasks executed under the intended protocol
checks.condition: n_records == 3 AND every record carries complete protocol metadata
per record: model identity, provider/route, temperature, agent-control cap, MAX_AGENT_CALLS, task_id all present and equal to the frozen values

checks.description: 3/3 valid final outputs OR failure explicitly classified
checks.condition: per task: valid_final_count > 0 OR empty_reason in (truncation, round_cap, parser_failure, infrastructure)
any record with malformed_count > 0 must have empty_reason == parser_failure
pricing preflight checks.no_drift is True AND every record's scientific model == qwen/qwen3-coder AND route contains deepinfra/turbo
every record's agent_control cap, temperature (0.0), and MAX_AGENT_CALLS (8) equal the frozen values
cumulative calibration USD <= frozen calibration ceiling (proportional share of the budget model's recommended ceiling) after the cumulative-USD guard

checks.description: 0 instrument-class tool errors across the whole calibration run
checks.condition: per-call sidecar classification: 0 tool_error in the INSTRUMENT_ERROR class. Instrument class = the 30-file-limit defect ('Max distinct files limit...'), 'Cannot read file' on a path that exists as an allowed UTF-8 text file in the workspace, and 'Skipped path' for a path inside the ArtifactUniverse. Agent-class errors ('Invalid path', 'Not a file', 'Not a directory', 'Not a file or directory', 'Empty query') and frozen-policy limits ('File too large', 'Binary file') are reported, NOT gating. Fail-closed: an unknown/unclassifiable tool error counts as instrument.

checks.description: at least one task made >= 1 successful read_file
checks.condition: max over tasks of successful read_file count >= 1; else STOP_FOR_REVIEW (the agent was blind)

stop_rule_v2: Calibration-3b STOPs if: CG-10 or CG-11 fails; the cost ratio to the budget-v2 worst case is > 1.2 on any task (BUDGET_MODEL_V2_WRONG); any new instrument-class error appears; scientific configuration drifts; or completing the task would require another behavior-changing fix.
report_only: per task: total LLM calls, successful read_file count, successful search calls with hits, instrument errors, agent-misuse errors, frozen-policy-limit events, rejected repeated requests, search-files-scanned, returned search results, search-result-cap hits, unique surfaced paths, observation truncation, finish-reason distribution, prompt/completion/total tokens, actual USD cost, actual/worst-case budget ratio. Distinguish GATE PASS from INSTRUMENT VALID.
truncation_handling: Report exact cap-hit / truncation counts from the first-class telemetry. Use the frozen G2 cap rule. Do NOT invent a post-calibration cap change.
performance_rule: No F1-based calibration continuation rule is frozen. Calibration F1 alone MUST NOT tune or cancel the main experiment. No labels are loaded or scored for Calibration-3b.
evaluation: scripts/wp1b_calibration_gate.py --gate v2 evaluates these checks against a calibration results directory (ZERO API, deterministic).
